use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Math
use System.Random

let random = Random(5)

next_line() -> string is
    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        throw System.Exception("input ended before the game did")
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")
    line.trim()
si

ask(prompt: string, low: int, high: int) -> int is
    let value mut = 0

    write_line("{prompt} ({low}-{high})?")

    while
        !int.try_parse(next_line(), value ref) \/
        value < low \/ value > high
    do
        write_line("a whole number from {low} to {high}, please")
    od

    value
si

tally(text: string, letter: char) -> int =>
    text |> filter(c => c == letter) |> count()

score(code: string, guess: string, palette: string) -> string is
    let exact =
        (0..code.length) |> filter(i => code[i] == guess[i]) |> count()

    let common =
        palette
            |> map(c => Math.min(tally(code, c), tally(guess, c)))
            |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)

    ""
        .pad_right(exact, 'X')
        .pad_right(common, 'O')
        .pad_right(code.length, '-')
si

let colours = ask("how many colours", 2, 20)

write_line("may colours repeat in the code (y/n)?")
let repeats = next_line().to_lower().starts_with("y")

let longest = if repeats then 10 else Math.min(10, colours) fi
let length = ask("how long is the code", 4, longest)
let guesses = ask("how many guesses", 7, 20)

let palette = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST".substring(0, colours)
let pool = LIST[char](palette)

let code = (
    let chosen = System.Text.StringBuilder()

    for _ in 0..length do
        let at = random.next(pool.count)
        chosen.append(pool[at])

        if !repeats then
            pool.remove_at(at)
        fi
    od

    chosen.to_string())

let history = LIST[string]()

write_line("guess a code of {length} letters from {palette}")

let solved mut = false

while !solved /\ history.count < guesses do
    let guess = next_line().to_upper()

    let valid =
        guess.length == length /\
        guess |> all(c => palette.contains(c))

    if !valid then
        write_line("{length} letters from {palette}, please")
        continue
    fi

    let result = score(code, guess, palette)
    history.add("{history.count + 1,2}. {guess}  {result}")

    for line in history do
        write_line(line)
    od

    solved = guess =~ code
od

write_line(
    if solved then "you found it"
    else "out of guesses; the code was {code}"
    fi)
